title: Signature GPU Lens — Lens concept
description: The Signature GPU Lens is Manon's original GPU inspector: it shows every spec GPU-Z shows, but each number arrives with a one-line explanation of what it means. A beginner learns the card while reading it; an expert skips the lessons and reads the numbers.

title: Signature GPU Lens — Lens install
description: The Lens is one signed executable with no installer and no admin rights needed, reading the same registers GPU-Z reads. Its first run builds a card passport — identity, firmware, and baseline clocks — stored locally for every later comparison.

title: Signature GPU Lens — Identity lens
description: The identity lens cross-checks the card's reported name against its device ID, shader count, and memory bus from an offline ledger. A mismatch lights up immediately, which makes the Lens a fake-card detector first and a spec sheet second.

description: The Lens annotates shaders, TMUs, and ROPs with what each unit does per frame, turning three bare numbers into a working mental model. Hovering a count shows the fillrate it produces at the current clock, computed live.

title: Signature GPU Lens — Fillrate truth
description: The Lens recomputes fillrates from unit counts and the live clock rather than trusting the driver's reported figure. If the recomputed number disagrees with the tab, the Lens says which one it believes and why.

title: Signature GPU Lens — Memory truth
description: The memory lens shows type, size, bus, and bandwidth with the arithmetic visible: 256-bit at 21 Gbps per pin is 672 GB/s, shown as a formula, not a magic number. Resizable BAR status sits beside it, since BAR off can cost real frames.

title: Signature GPU Lens — Thermal truth-teller
description: The thermal truth-teller plots GPU temp against hot spot and shades the normal 10–15 C band, so an abnormal gap is visible as color, not just numbers. It also estimates cooler-mount quality from the gap's behavior under load steps.

title: Signature GPU Lens — Limit finder
description: The limit finder watches which cap binds the card second by second and totals the time spent at each: power, thermal, voltage, or idle. Overclockers get a pie chart of lost performance instead of a blinking PerfCap code.

title: Signature GPU Lens — Clock story
description: The clock story records base, boost, and live clock as a timeline, so throttling shows up as a visible sag, not a single low reading. Each sag is annotated with the limit that caused it, pulled from the limit finder.

title: Signature GPU Lens — Link prover
description: The link prover runs a graduated 3D load and records the PCIe lane count and generation at each step, proving the slot negotiates correctly under stress. A card that drops lanes under load has a slot or riser problem, and the prover names it.
march: MILLION MARCH · record 11 of 15 in this archive · archive marches to a 1,000,000-record target — in progress

title: Signature GPU Lens — Firmware vault
description: The Lens archives the card's VBIOS with a hash at first sight and warns if it ever changes unexpectedly. Before any flash it stages the backup, the new image, and a recovery plan in that order.
